description: A painted interior of a dark wood-panelled staircase with a carved banister, a drum kit set up on a wooden landing with cymbals and a snare, and microphones hanging on cables from the upper gallery. A seated, shadowy figure sits beside the drums. Through an open door at the back, a vintage dark van is parked on gravel under trees. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
